scenarios.task: We migrated from server sessions to OIDC via Keycloak. Update the security context.
scenarios.setup: Repo has an existing security context record saying 'auth: express-session + bcrypt local users'. Code now uses passport-openidconnect with Keycloak; the old user table remains for a service account.
rubric: Edits the existing context record rather than creating a second conflicting one
Auth model now states OIDC/Keycloak and notes the remaining local service account as an open item or caveat
Cites code evidence (file names) for the change instead of just trusting the user's sentence
Flags that previously planned checks relying on session handling may need re-planning
Contains no credentials, client secrets or tokens
